d:
Every great mystery leaves behind clues, but some discoveries change the direction of an entire investigation. From lost treasures and ancient relics to historical mysteries that have puzzled the world, Josh Gates follows the evidence across continents, uncovering leads that bring him closer to the truth. Sometimes, one clue is all it takes to change everything.
Watch Expedition Unknown, S2, Episodes 6, 18 & 10; S1, Episodes 3 & 7; S3, Episodes 2 & 11; S4, Episode 2; and S7, Episodes 4 & 12 on Discovery Channel India.
